import os, sys, sqlite3, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import

class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.c)

    def snapshot(self):
        return list_contacts(self.c)

    def test_insert_and_update_counts(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "old@x.com", "Old")
        result = import_contacts(self.c, [
            {"email": "  New@X.com ", "name": " Newbie "},
            {"email": "old@x.com", "name": "Old"},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), [("new@x.com", "Newbie"), ("old@x.com", "Old")])

    def test_update_changes_name(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "a@b.com", "Alice")
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, [{"email": "A@B.com", "name": "Alicia"}]), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), [("a@b.com", "Alicia")])

    def test_empty_batch(self):
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_invalid_rows_reject_whole_batch(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x.com", "Keep")
        before = self.snapshot()
        bad_batches = [
            ["not a dict"],
            [{"email": "a@b.com"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "A", "extra": 1}],
            [{"email": "a@@b.com", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@b", "name": "A"}, {"email": "@b.com", "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "A"}, {"email": "c@ d.com", "name": "C"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "   "}],
            [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": 5}],
            [{"email": "x@y.com", "name": "X"}, {"email": " X@Y.COM ", "name": "Dup"}],
        ]
        for batch in bad_batches:
            with self.subTest(batch=batch):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, batch)
                self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@x.com", "Keep")
        before = self.snapshot()
        self.c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER fail BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x.com' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(self.c, [
                {"email": "ok@x.com", "name": "OK"},
                {"email": "keep@x.com", "name": "Changed"},
                {"email": "boom@x.com", "name": "Boom"},
            ])
        self.assertEqual(self.snapshot(), before)

    def test_api_envelope(self):
        handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Alice"})
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [{"email": "c@d.com", "name": "Carl"}]}),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        for bad in [[], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}, {"rows": []}]:
            with self.subTest(payload=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(self.c, bad)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b.com", "Alice"), ("c@d.com", "Carl")])

    def test_large_batch(self):
        rows = [{"email": f"u{i}@x.com", "name": f"U{i}"} for i in range(1200)]
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, rows), {"inserted": 1200, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, rows[:700]), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 700})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
